item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 01/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a humid southerly airstream, it will be misty in the morning and at night and warm during the day over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of southern China later tomorrow to Tuesday at first. Temperatures will fall slightly over the region. An upper-air disturbance will bring showers to Guangdong on Tuesday. The northeast monsoon will persist over the coast of Guangdong in the middle to latter parts of this week. The weather will improve gradually with slightly cooler mornings over the region.

Date/Month: 02/03 (Monday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3, becoming northeast force 4 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Coastal mist in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day. A few showers with chance of thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 21 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
